column5: GROUP: **Across crates** | 1. **Source span that identifies a called declaration (call custody).** `S02/selection.rs:493-521` over resolved trees; `BTE/const_generic_expressions.rs:43-100` over typed trees. (checked) Same job, with two shared error strings. Both ask for an evidence requirement first. Then stage 02 tests kind-based provenance before the plain source span; the build-time copy tests the plain source span (`:55`) before kind-based provenance (`:59-72`). For a source-less entry state, stage 02 takes the first State child of the parent (`:536-544`); the build-time copy requires exactly one owning machine and the first state of its roster (`:78-93`).

GROUP: **Across crates** | 2. **Entry state of a machine.** Three identical bodies in one crate: `BTE/machine_execution.rs:737`, `:1833`, `BTE/const_evaluation.rs:2940` (checked). Other rules for the same question: `S02/selection.rs:1645-1660`, `S02/symbols_targets.rs:326`, `S02/symbols.rs:4906-4911`, `S02/selection_authored.rs:597-604` (first state).

GROUP: **Across crates** | 3. **Is a domain name exposed to this reference.** Stated single law `symbols/src/table.rs:622` (called from `S02/preparation.rs:526, 648`, `S02/selection.rs:2213, 2224`). Re-implemented at `S02/selection.rs:2585-2605` (module paths as joined strings; `authored == domain_path` passes) and `S03/type_reference.rs:464-486` (module symbols; import paths as strings; no reference means not exposed). (checked) Same job, different keys. Three more candidate pools with their own tie-breaks: `S02/symbols.rs:1576`, `S02/symbols.rs:2121`, `S02/selection.rs:2206-2225`; visibility re-derived again at `S02/preparation.rs:299, 509, 583`.

GROUP: **Across crates** | 4. **Default ranking view for a single-subject `terminates by`.** `S02/lowering_machine.rs:1956-2037` (parameter found by name string; also accepts a `.len` member; no step limit) and `S03/lowerer.rs:174-245` (parameter found by symbol; 128-step limit; runs only when stage 02 left the view empty). (checked) Same rule: slice or fixed array gives `SLICE_LENGTH`; `u8`..`u64` gives `NAT_DESCENDING`. The stage 02 comment says it mirrors the checker's `decreasing_value_kind` "EXACTLY" (`:1946-1955`); that third site was not read by any record here (suspected).

GROUP: **Across crates** | 5. **Strip `Reference` and `Constrained` to the base type.** `S02/symbols_expression_paths.rs:168` and `S03/call_and_product_selections.rs:320` (checked: same loop, different child fetch). Further peelers recorded: `S03/equality_and_exhaustiveness.rs:704, 724, 1948`; `S03/statement_lowering.rs:809`; `S03/expression_lowering.rs:2288`; `S03/lowerer.rs:221`; `S02/lowering_machine.rs:2007`; `S02/preparation_generic_uses.rs:1616, 1633`; `S02/preparation_const_evaluation.rs:5524-5529`; `S02/preparation_generic_data.rs:1362-1370`. 13 sites.

GROUP: **Across crates** | 6. **Walk every child of an expression node.** 20 hand-written walkers recorded: `S01/type_syntax_and_patterns.rs:49`; `S02/constant.rs:1550, 2066, 3887`; `S02/lowering.rs:1249`; `S02/lowering_statement.rs:1844`; `S02/preparation.rs:3214-3473`; `S02/preparation_generic_uses.rs:1266`; `S02/selection.rs:326`; `S02/selection_authored.rs:1087`; `S02/symbols.rs:336, 1284, 2575`; `S02/symbols_expressions.rs:927`; `BTE/const_evaluation.rs:878, 1038, 3488`; `BTE/const_generic_expressions.rs:714, 785`; `S04/conformance.rs:659`. They differ in which children they visit: `S02/lowering_statement.rs:1866-1873` ignores `machine_arguments` and `atomic.result`; `S02/selection.rs:346` skips saved subjects that `S02/selection_authored.rs:1087` follows; `BTE/const_evaluation.rs:2461-2481` (syntax level) sees only six node kinds.

GROUP: **Across crates** | 7. **Toolchain-file custody test.** Written inline in each crate that needs it (sites in spelling group 1). `layout.omg` alone: five inline copies in `BTE/layouts.rs` (checked) plus `S03/lib.rs:88-98`; my grep also finds it in typed-trees (5), validation (1) and stage 06 (1), outside this area. `reflect.omg` name list: two copies in `BTE/const_generic_expressions.rs` plus `validation/src/machine_parameters_and_bindings.rs:3399` and `S04/selection_and_reflection.rs:2514` (grepped by unit 038 and by me; not read).

GROUP: **Across crates** | 8. **`Carry::Portable` expansion to every carry permission.** `S01/contracts_and_parameters.rs:292-325`, `S01/type_syntax_and_patterns.rs:877-889`, `S03/type_reference.rs:30-49`; refusal by the same name at `S02/preparation_const_evaluation.rs:2699`. Unit 041 "suspected" other grammar sites; unit 040's record and my grep confirm the stage 01 pair.
